summary: Frontend-only verification of TFCS Mainframe Spec 1.0 + password visibility toggles. All 14 UI/integration checks passed. Login/Signup password eye-toggles work, owner (inbox@twofungis.ca) authenticates via Supabase, TFCS Mainframe sidebar link renders (with Shield + Crown icons), navigation to /app/mainframe works, Owner Access card + green checkmark + email display correctly, and all 4 Foundation Verification items are checked green. System Diagnostics also load correctly for the owner.

issues: 'Owner Access' heading (white text) has low contrast on the amber-tinted gradient background at top of role card. Consider darker text or stronger background opacity.
QUICK EXPENSE and AI SUPPORT floating buttons on the right overlap the System Diagnostics cards (Employees stat is partially obscured at 1920px viewport).

action_items: Optional: improve 'Owner Access' heading contrast on the role card gradient.
Optional: reduce floating action button z-index overlap on wider viewports (Mainframe page).
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.jsx uses supabase.auth.getSession() (correct) for TFCS role check, while MainframePage.jsx reads token directly from localStorage key 'sb-oiocmchdtllqpszciuxh-auth-token'. Two different token retrieval patterns for the same purpose - unify to a helper to prevent drift if Supabase changes storage keys.
MainframePage.jsx has hardcoded Supabase project ref 'oiocmchdtllqpszciuxh' in the localStorage lookup - should derive from REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL env to keep environments configurable.

AppLayout.jsx contains hardcoded FOUNDER_EMAILS list duplicated with backend logic; consider fetching from /api/tfcs/role/me exclusively and hiding the sidebar link only when has_role=true, to avoid stale hardcoded lists.
Two 404 errors observed in console after login (endpoints not identified from logs). Non-blocking but should be audited by main agent to remove noisy failed requests.
test_credentials: inbox@twofungis.ca / TradeOS2024! (Owner) - authenticated successfully; TFCS role API returned {has_role:true, role:'owner'}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend password toggles use data-testid='password-toggle' on both LoginPage and SignUpPage (Login has one; Signup has 'password-toggle' + 'confirm-password-toggle'). Owner login redirects to /app/dashboard, and role check calls GET /api/tfcs/role/me which correctly returns role='owner' for inbox@twofungis.ca. Sidebar nav-mainframe becomes visible after role check completes (~2-3s). Service worker triggers an initial 'Controller changed, reloading...' after first page load; give the page 3-5s to settle before interacting.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no failures. Initial test attempt saw one flaky 'toggle' fail due to service-worker-triggered page reload; adding a 5s settle wait after load resolved it.
